user_direction: 不用绿色主色；以 Awwwards、Webby Awards、FWA 获奖级网站为品质目标；简约高级；先生成三个界面和加载效果设计图。

visual_direction.composition: 非对称编辑式排版；大字号；细线；暖白留白；低圆角

notes: 全部为静态设计效果图，未实施页面代码或真实动画。
课程、章节、封面均为设计示例，不代表当前检索结果。
获奖级仅为设计品质目标，不声称获得上述奖项。
动效分镜的小尺寸界面用于演示过渡，实际界面文案以三张主图为准。

motion.loading: 由真实任务状态驱动，使用不定进度

Typography: confident large Chinese black sans-serif display headings, restrained elegant type spacing, smaller functional Chinese sans-serif; small English uppercase section eyebrows, monospaced step numerals. This is a Chinese learning tool, never turn it into an English marketing landing page. Typography and exact alignment should feel designed by an excellent independent digital studio.
Shared shell: minimal 68px-ish header, left fine outlined book glyph and "项目制知识引导小精灵" in medium 16px text, center-right three fine understated numbered stages "01 项目描述", "02 选择知识点", "03 推荐视频". Active stage dark with a short cobalt underline, previous steps small checkmark, future light gray. Far right quiet "我的项目" with a tiny arrow. Hairline below header. Large generous page margins.
Use an editorial asymmetric 12-column grid for content: page title area on left about one third, main interaction on right about two thirds. Upper title eyebrow "PROJECT / LEARNING". Large typographic phase number in subtle warm gray as a restrained anchor, not a giant illustration. All interfaces feel like the same system, subtle bottom-left footer "界面概念 · 示例内容".
Constraints: premium quiet visual interest using grid, rhythm, typography and meaningful content. NO green or teal anywhere. No decorative mascot, floating spheres, charts unrelated to the task, fake ratings, extra features, repetitive dashboard widgets, badges, or excessive pill chips. Chinese text must be crisp and verbatim.
Primary request: screen 1 PROJECT DESCRIPTION. First step active. A strong asymmetric composition with significant breathing room.
Left editorial column: small eyebrow "01 / PROJECT BRIEF"; prominent two-line Chinese heading "从一个想法，" then "开始你的项目。" in beautifully set near-black 44-52px equivalent type; muted two-line supporting copy "描述你想实现的功能，" then "让学习围绕项目展开。". Lower in this left column a small thin rule and quiet label "下一步" above "梳理需要学习的知识点" with tiny forward arrow. A very large low-contrast outlined "01" anchored near the lower left, elegant numeral rather than an illustration.
Right main workspace: elevated by immaculate typesetting, NOT floating puffy card. Crisp white writing panel with a 1px edge and 6px corners, generous inner padding; clean label "项目名称" and an almost borderless single-line input with bottom rule, filled "Excel 成绩分析工具". Below label "我想实现的功能" and a large open text-entry area with only a fine boundary, filled exactly three separate lines: "读取本地 Excel 成绩表"; "计算各科平均分并绘图"; "导出统计结果，不需要登录或联网部署". Large blank writing space under the text suggests room to think.
Under writing area muted helper "直接描述功能，不需要先知道专业术语。". A restrained separated disclosure row "学习语言与平台偏好" and small plus.
Bottom panel action bar: small thin draft icon and "草稿自动保存" on left, single sharp cobalt rectangle button "分析项目" with right arrow on right.
Below panel right aligned small link "直接搜索知识点 ↗". Header navigation and editorial column do not compete with input. A small fine bottom-page baseline adds finish. Art-directed, calm, mature, precise, truly polished application rather than generic admin SaaS template.
No input image reference: start a new visual direction, do not copy any previous green layout.
